title: Smt. Rama Devi v. Dakshinanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd.
coram: Amreshwar Pratap Sahi, J. and Vivek Kumar Birla, J.
disposition: Writ disposed; respondent no. 2 to consider Clause 6.14 installments and decide bill correction within two months.
headnote: A domestic consumer in arrears sought easy installments and bill correction. The Division Bench disposed of the writ by directing respondent no. 2, on a certified copy filed within 15 days with the consumer's claim, to examine the grievance, extend such installment benefits as may be permissible under Clause 6.14 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005, and decide bill-correction within two months.
facts: Smt. Rama Devi, a domestic electricity consumer of Dakshinanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd., petitioned the Allahabad High Court after arrears accrued and payment was defaulted. Through counsel she offered to deposit the dues in easy installments and asked that the competent authority also correct her bill, submitting that both powers lay with respondent no. 2. Counsel for the Electricity Department appeared. The Division Bench heard the parties on a one-page writ and issued time-bound directions to that officer.

holding_units.holding: If the petitioner files a certified copy of this order before respondent no. 2 within 15 days along with her claim, that officer shall examine her grievance and extend such installment benefits as may be permissible under Clause 6.14 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005, and shall decide the bill-correction grievance within two months.

not_decided.point: Correctness of the bill and quantum of arrears
not_decided.note: Left to respondent no. 2 to decide the bill-correction grievance within two months.

not_decided.point: Whether the petitioner in fact qualifies for Clause 6.14 installments
not_decided.note: Installments to be extended only as may be permissible under Clause 6.14, not granted on the writ.
